LanguageData.RMush_AteButton.stages.0.label: subtle button mushroom flavor
LanguageData.RMush_AteButton.stages.0.description: I ate button mushrooms. Their subtle aroma and mild flavor were nice.
LanguageData.RMush_AteShiitake.stages.0.label: rich shiitake umami
LanguageData.RMush_AteShiitake.stages.0.description: I ate some fragrant shiitake. The savory flavor was really good.
LanguageData.RMush_AteOyster.stages.0.label: subtle oyster mushroom umami
LanguageData.RMush_AteOyster.stages.0.description: The oyster mushrooms were soft and subtly tasty. Quite nice, really.
LanguageData.RMush_AteKingOyster.stages.0.label: springy king oyster mushrooms
LanguageData.RMush_AteKingOyster.stages.0.description: I ate king oyster mushrooms. I liked chewing their thick flesh.
LanguageData.RMush_AteEnoki.stages.0.label: crisp enoki
LanguageData.RMush_AteEnoki.stages.0.description: I liked the crisp enoki stems. They were nice to chew.
LanguageData.RMush_AteWoodEar.stages.0.label: chewy wood ear mushrooms
LanguageData.RMush_AteWoodEar.stages.0.description: I ate wood ear mushrooms. Their chewy texture was really nice.
LanguageData.RMush_AteBeech.stages.0.label: crunchy beech mushrooms
LanguageData.RMush_AteBeech.stages.0.description: The beech mushrooms were subtly nutty. I liked their crunch, too.
LanguageData.RMush_AteMaitake.stages.0.label: rich maitake flavor
LanguageData.RMush_AteMaitake.stages.0.description: The maitake had a rich, nutty flavor. I really enjoyed them.
LanguageData.RMush_AteLionsMane.stages.0.label: tender lion's mane
LanguageData.RMush_AteLionsMane.stages.0.description: I liked the tender flesh of the lion's mane mushroom. Its subtle sweetness was nice, too.
LanguageData.RMush_AteMatsutake.stages.0.label: pine-scented matsutake
LanguageData.RMush_AteMatsutake.stages.0.description: I ate some wonderfully fragrant matsutake. The pine aroma filling my mouth was fantastic.
